definitions: Any of the scales around a reptile's eye.

A solid object in the shape of a circle.
A circumscribing object, (roughly) circular and hollow, looking like an annual ring, earring, finger ring etc.
A circumscribing object, (roughly) circular and hollow, looking like an annual ring, earring, finger ring etc.
To make an incision around; to girdle; to cut away a circular tract of bark from a tree in order to kill it.

blocks.text: In scaled reptiles, the ocular scales are those forming the margin of the eye. The name originates from the term oculus which is Latin for 'eye' and, in the broadest sense, refers to a scale associated with the eye. The numbers of these scales present, and sometimes the shapes and sizes, are some of many characteristics used to differentiate species from one another.
